facts.text: Maria recently gave talks at a homeless shelter where she volunteers, and she received compliments from other volunteers.

evidence.quote: I recently gave a few talks at the homeless shelter I volunteer at. It was really fulfilling and I received lots of compliments from other volunteers.

facts.text: Maria bought a cross necklace to feel closer to her faith, which has made her happy.

evidence.quote: I bought a cross necklace to feel closer to my faith- which has made me happy.

facts.text: Maria feels blessed to know the people at the homeless shelter, who have become like family to her.

evidence.quote: The people at the shelter have become like family to me. I feel really blessed to know them.

facts.text: Maria shared a photo of a group of people standing around a table filled with food, which she described as warming her heart and filling her with hope.

evidence.quote: Here's a pic from last week. Seeing everyone come together warms my heart and fills me with hope.
